digest.component_or_area: completion-recovery context validation and close-gate failure messaging
propositions: A ticket whose text exceeds 24,000 chars cannot reach closed status via bounded completion recovery, blocking correct merged work from transitioning to closed without --force-close
A step-budget exhaustion during completion verification incorrectly reports the remedy as 'install the agents extra' instead of surfacing the actual cause and model-backed diagnostic
The criteria-chars cap (32,000) exceeds the context-chars cap (24,000), creating incoherent mutual bounds where valid criteria sets are rejected on context grounds
The compaction approach to handle over-cap context silently deletes entire child tickets on epic closure while reporting only comment removal, constituting a signed-false-pass vector

Raising the context cap to 100,000 chars and refusing without elision, paired with cause-based remedy selection rather than exception-type dispatch, resolves the defect while preserving the fail-closed cost safeguard
